# PawnIO modules

`LpcIO.bin` (Super I/O access) and `AMDFamily17.bin` (AMD Ryzen SMN access) are the signed
modules from [PawnIO.Modules](https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules) 0.2.11, embedded
unmodified into `fan-lite.exe` and loaded through the PawnIO driver at runtime.

They are licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 (`COPYING`). Their source
code is available at https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules.
